questions.explain: Multiply across: (3 × 2) / (5 × 3) = 6/15 = 2/5. Adding tops and bottoms (5/8) and dividing (9/10) are common slips.

questions.stem: Of 200 people, 30% are smokers. Of the smokers, 20% have a cough. How many smokers have a cough?
questions.explain: 30% of 200 is 60 smokers. Then 20% of 60 is 12.

questions.stem: In how many ways can you choose 2 balls from 8 (order does not matter)?
P(A) = 0.5, P(B) = 0.3, and A and B cannot happen together. What is P(A or B)?
questions.explain: For mutually exclusive events the probabilities add: 0.5 + 0.3 = 0.8.

questions.stem: A and B are independent with P(A) = 0.5 and P(B) = 0.4. What is P(A and B)?
questions.explain: For independent events the probabilities multiply: 0.5 × 0.4 = 0.2.
